name: ReUseCloud_02_DecisionFlow
frames:
Condition: an integer from 0 to 100.
Failure probability: from 0 to 1.
Financial inputs must be nonnegative.

Resale requires condition >= 70.
Repair requires condition >= 30.
Recycling remains eligible.
Compare contribution after costs and repair risk.

Orion 15 recommends Recycle at -520.
A negative contribution requires manager review.
Demo display currency: BRL.

Asynchronous evaluation advances the status.
Authorized approval requires Evaluated.
Changed inputs reset the approval workflow.

The overview and existing statuses were inspected in Salesforce.
This sequence explains the Apex policy; it is not footage of every approval click.
